notes: "The asset library keeps the original material available for the next revision. These two DNA views, coordinates and distance table come from one public structure. After import, Assets lets us locate the material and reuse it on a page; the source record and method remain with the project. A new composition should not require inventing a similar-looking figure with different data. We will use this material in the scientific example."

designIntent.purpose: The asset library keeps the original material available for the next revision
keep: Keep actual product captures, original scientific data/assets, attribution and the demonstrated function. Do not fragment ordinary prose into a fake table.
designIntent.requestedChange: Explain the product and its use; interpret the founder’s account to choose the emphasis.
